label: Delegation
title: Delegation
subtitle: Hands off a complete sub-task to another agent and waits for the result. The delegated agent runs autonomously with its own tools and reasoning chain, and returns its output when done.
whenToUse: Use when a task is large enough to deserve a dedicated agent running independently. Each delegated task gets its own conversation thread visible in the Views panel.

methods.name: Delegate to Agent
methods.description: Assigns a task to a target agent and blocks until it completes. Returns the agent's final response. Creates a new sub-conversation thread in the sidebar.

mediaCaption: A delegation action in the main chat showing the task, the target agent, a status indicator, and the result once complete
tips: Each delegation creates a sub-conversation thread in the Views panel.
Make sure the target agent has the right tools assigned for the delegated task.
